evals.name: flange-bolt-circle
evals.prompt: I need a pipe flange for a 50 mm pipe: 120 mm outside diameter, 12 mm thick, 50 mm bore through the middle, and six M10 bolt holes evenly spaced on a 95 mm bolt circle.
evals.expected_output: A 120 x 120 x 12 mm disc on the floor, centred, with a 50 mm through-bore and six ~11 mm clearance holes on a 95 mm pitch circle (circular pattern).

checks.text: Bore goes all the way through
Bore plus six bolt holes are cut
Material between the bore and the bolt circle
Volume fits a 50 mm bore and six M10 clearance holes (10-11.5 mm)

evals.name: plate-corner-holes
evals.prompt: Make a mounting plate 100 mm long (X) by 60 mm wide (Y) and 5 mm thick, with a 5 mm diameter hole 8 mm in from each corner.
evals.expected_output: A 100 x 60 x 5 mm plate, centred, with four 5 mm through-holes centred at (±42, ±22).

checks.text: Hole at the +X +Y corner
Hole at the -X +Y corner
Hole at the +X -Y corner
Hole at the -X -Y corner
Plate centre is solid
Volume matches four 5 mm holes (not 5 mm radius)

evals.name: mug-hollow
evals.prompt: Design a coffee mug, about 85 mm tall and 80 mm in diameter, 4 mm thick walls, with a handle on the side.
evals.expected_output: A hollow cylinder 80 mm across and 85 mm tall with a closed floor, open top and a handle joined to the side.

checks.text: 85 mm tall
Footprint is the 80 mm body plus a handle
Open top: the cavity reaches down into the mug
Has a closed floor
Mug is hollow (fills under 40% of its bounding box)

evals.name: enclosure-with-posts
evals.prompt: Electronics enclosure base, open top: 120 x 80 x 40 mm outside (X x Y x Z), 2.5 mm walls and floor, plus four 6 mm diameter mounting posts in the inside corners, 20 mm tall, each with a 2.5 mm pilot hole.
evals.expected_output: An open-top box 120 x 80 x 40 mm with 2.5 mm walls and floor, four 6 mm posts in the inner corners rising from the floor, each with a pilot hole.

checks.text: Cavity is open from the top down to the floor
Floor is solid
+X wall is solid at 2.5 mm thickness
Shell plus four posts are added
Cavity plus four pilot holes are cut
Enclosure is hollow (fills under 30% of its bounding box)

evals.name: inch-spacer
evals.prompt: Model a nylon spacer for a #10 machine screw: 1/2 inch outside diameter and 3/4 inch long.
evals.expected_output: A tube 12.7 mm OD x 19.05 mm long with a ~5 mm through-hole (#10 clearance), converted to millimetres.

checks.text: Converted inches to mm: 12.7 x 12.7 x 19.05
Bore is #10 clearance size (4.8-5.6 mm)

evals.name: vague-phone-stand
evals.prompt: can you make me a simple stand to prop my phone up on my desk
evals.expected_output: Some reasonable phone stand, made without asking questions: sits on the floor, desk-object sized, not a solid block.

checks.text: Phone-stand sized (every dimension 40-250 mm)
Not just a solid block (fills under 70% of its bounding box)
